scope_rule: Likely relevant requires lifecycle-spanning orchestration, gates, or dependencies, or team/organization coordination, capacity, flow, or delivery outcomes. An isolated SDLC task or an SDLC label alone is insufficient.
sampling_method: full population in immutable records.csv order because the complete population is 29 records
interpretation_boundary: Full-population metadata-level query-precision appraisal only; these are not screening, eligibility, inclusion, critical-appraisal, or PRISMA decisions.

decisions.reason: The primary unit is data and AI pipeline self-healing; software delivery is only one adaptable environment and metadata provides no software-team coordination or delivery outcome.
